title: Grid Tech Map (v2) config
description: Editor-supplied configuration for the grid-tech-map widget (v2; replaces grid-tech-market-map). Every field is optional; widget falls back to documented defaults.

initialCategoryId.description: Category id to show on first render. Must match an id present in the widget's bundled dataset (or the editor-supplied `categories` override).

hideCategorySelector.description: When true, the category `<select>` is hidden and only the initial category renders. Useful for single-category embeds.

categories.description: Override the bundled dataset entirely. Each entry must be a Category object with id, name, optional yAxisMax, and a subCategories array.

name.description: Display name shown in the selector and as the chart heading.

yAxisMax.description: Optional fixed Y-axis ceiling. Falls back to a computed value when omitted.

name.description: Technology name; also the key into labelPositions.

labelPositions.description: Per-tech-name label-placement override. Keys are technology names; values are one of left, right, top, bottom, top-right.

colors.description: Override the default CAGR-bucket palette. Hex strings. Editors who supply an override own the contrast budget; the catalog default ships an AA-audited palette.
